detected_fault: power consumption issues with random spikes in power usage and/or heat
suggested_solution: Monitor power consumption using tools like powertop --auto-tune and auto-cpufreq to identify patterns and potential causes.
Adjust power settings in Fedora, such as disabling unnecessary features or reducing screen brightness, to reduce power consumption.
Update drivers and BIOS to optimize performance and battery life.
Consider a lighter desktop environment like GNOME Shell or XFCE.
